multi_corpus_asr_evaluation_research.title: Rethinking Evaluation in ASR: Are Our Models Robust Enough?
multi_corpus_asr_evaluation_research.finding: The study reports that average WER over a sufficiently broad benchmark set is a better proxy for real-world noisy data than a single-dataset score.

upstream_sdk_review_2026_09_23.evidence_scope: Upstream release notes and issue/PR evidence motivate English and multilingual long-form SDK comparisons only; they do not establish a Presspeech quality or latency improvement.

upstream_encoder_precision_2026_09_23.reported_failure_class: Right-context-sensitive word corruption in a single 15-second Ukrainian Parakeet v3 CoreML window; not a chunk-seam-only failure
upstream_encoder_precision_2026_09_23.upstream_root_cause_assessment: Controlled encoder substitution attributed the reported corruption to the shipped mixed-fp16/6-bit-LUT Encoder.mlmodelc; the report and implementation are upstream evidence, not a Presspeech reproduction.

candidate_encoder.name: Encoder_v2.mlmodelc
candidate_encoder.upstream_controlled_repro_result: Decoded all three reported cuts correctly in the same-input substitution; broad WER and Apple Neural Engine latency checks remain outstanding in the implementation report.
candidate_encoder.default_behavior: Opt-in only; the original encoder remains the default

upstream_encoder_precision_2026_09_23.presspeech_production_pin: FluidAudio v0.15.6 with the original encoder
upstream_encoder_precision_2026_09_23.presspeech_candidate_support: The benchmark has a candidate-only v3-int8-v2 comparison path; candidate revision c7246f4dc78d05f75cdfc5a550cd72ced0c658bf is documented in experiments/swift-bench/README.md.
recommended_checks: Compare production and candidate on identical pinned Ukrainian FLEURS fixtures and human-reviewed local dictation.
Exercise the existing Ukrainian context-variation fixtures and require candidate non-regression on sufficiently broad speech data.
Measure Apple Neural Engine latency, model-cache size, and memory before considering production use.
upstream_encoder_precision_2026_09_23.production_change: None; upstream isolated repro does not establish Presspeech-wide quality or latency benefit.

upstream_spanish_behavior_2026_09_23.reported_input: 14-second conversational Latin-American Spanish clip in one model window
upstream_spanish_behavior_2026_09_23.corrected_finding: The author corrected the initial CoreML/translation interpretation: the behavior was also reproduced, worse, with upstream full-precision Parakeet v3; the author attributed it to model behavior on spontaneous speech and an English prior.
upstream_spanish_behavior_2026_09_23.release_gate_coverage: English LibriSpeech and German FLEURS long-form are required; no Spanish-specific quality corpus is required.
upstream_spanish_behavior_2026_09_23.recommended_probe: ./run-spanish-language-probe.sh compares the same pinned FLEURS es_419 test clips with v3 auto and es script-filter hint; evaluate private spontaneous Spanish locally as separate evidence.
limitations: A single upstream report is not a Presspeech reproduction.
NVIDIA's model card describes automatic language detection; the reported explanation is the issue author's corrected hypothesis.
FLEURS is read speech and does not reproduce spontaneous dictation.
Presspeech's language hint filters output script and does not force a language.
upstream_spanish_behavior_2026_09_23.evidence_scope: Motivates a bounded Spanish evaluation only; no Presspeech WER, latency, or model-selection result is available.

default_same_pin_no_mel_comparison.corpus: required validated composed multi-window public corpus

notes: The benchmark measures compute latency, not energy use.
Both tested backends produced essentially identical transcripts on the synthetic audio.
Unified and Nemotron models are candidate-only and are not exposed in the app unless future benchmarks and real dictation tests prove they improve on v3.
The 2026-07-22 FluidAudio v0.15.5 recheck retained Parakeet TDT v3 because both Nemotron candidates had higher average and worst-case WER.
The current v0.15.6 production dependency still requires same-pin corpus evidence before an ASR release gate can pass.

Upstream v0.15.7-v0.15.8 ASR fixes and the v0.17.0 MLMultiArray optimization warrant a same-fixture SDK comparison. The upstream 11-second M3 Pro result is not a Presspeech measurement; no v0.17.0 quality or latency result is available for Presspeech.

FluidAudio's opt-in linear-int8 encoder resolves an upstream single-window Ukrainian repro in controlled substitution, but Presspeech has no candidate WER or Apple Neural Engine latency result; production remains on the original encoder.
